author: Russell Brand
description:
The UK government has announced it will roll out AI tutors to 450,000 people currently on free school meals to close the so-called attainment gap — and Russell Brand, who was himself on free school meals, has a very specific response. What was needed was not an AI teacher but healthier locally grown food, and the fact that neither of those things will ever happen under the current system is not an accident but a direct consequence of the principal problem Russell identifies in every episode: centralization. The announcement was paired with an AI jobs finder for the unemployed, and Russell asks whether anyone alive actually believes a single word of it.

author: Russell Brand
description:
A political operative who worked for Kamala Harris pushes Russell Brand live on camera to condemn the MAGA movement, framing his support for Trump as a contradiction of his own arguments about artificial political performance. Russell does not flinch — he tells the interviewer candidly that the institutions themselves are broken and corrupt beyond repair, that the Iran war and the Epstein disclosures marked a new fatigue even among previously enthusiastic Trump supporters, and that the results under Trump have been so similar to what Kamala Harris would have delivered that anyone still quibbling over partisan outcomes is doing exactly what the ruling class wants. They want your audience to hate me, Russell tells him. And right now we are all allowing ourselves to be played by the same class of people profiteering off the hatred.
